entities.name: GAPDH testis-specific
observations: Exact 432-aa sequence match to reviewed Rattus norvegicus UniProt Q9ESV6; assigned EC 1.2.1.12.
Catalyzes oxidation and phosphorylation of D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate to 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate using inorganic phosphate and NAD+. Annotation states function by similarity.

entities.name: GAPDH glycolysis reaction
observations: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + phosphate + NAD+ = (2R)-3-phosphoglyceroyl phosphate + NADH + H+ (Rhea RHEA:10300; EC 1.2.1.12).
